# HomePro Nigeria — On-Demand Home Services Platform

**Generated by**: Kajola Skill v2  
**Date**: 2026-07-25  
**Market**: Nigeria — Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt  
**Currency**: NGN  
**Payments**: Paystack (deposits + balance charges) + Cash tracking  
**Auth**: Phone OTP via Termii  
**SORF**: Full 18-stage lifecycle adapted for home services dispatch

---

## SECTION 1 — Product Requirements Document (PRD)

### 1.1 Vision

HomePro is Nigeria's trusted on-demand home services marketplace — connecting households in Lagos, Abuja, and Port Harcourt with verified, background-checked providers for cleaning, plumbing, electrical repairs, AC servicing, painting, and appliance repair. Every provider passes identity verification and a background check before going live. Every job ends with photo evidence uploaded by the provider, so customers and homeowners have an audit trail. The platform closes the gap between the fragmented informal home-services market (nannies from WhatsApp, plumbers from word-of-mouth) and the reliability of a curated, insured, and rated professional network. In three years, HomePro is the default home-services layer for 1.5 million Nigerian households — the brand synonymous with "show up, do the job right, leave a clean before-and-after."

### 1.2 Target Personas

**Persona 1 — Chioma, 34 (Customer / Homeowner)**
- Lagos Island, tech-comfortable, dual-income household
- Jobs-to-be-done: reliable cleaner 2×/week, emergency plumber within 4 hours, verified electrician for renovations
- Frustrations: workers don't show up, no price transparency before booking, WhatsApp-only coordination with no receipt, no recourse when quality is bad

**Persona 2 — Emeka, 28 (Service Provider)**
- Certified electrician, Lagos Mainland, Android phone, intermittent data
- Jobs-to-be-done: steady daily job flow without middlemen, transparent payment timeline, track earnings by week
- Frustrations: time wasted on unserious clients, cash-only leaves no record, no platform protecting him from unfair disputes

**Persona 3 — Mrs. Adesanya, 52 (Property Manager)**
- Manages 12 rental units in Lekki and Victoria Island
- Jobs-to-be-done: schedule monthly cleaning + quarterly AC servicing across all units, manage invoices per property, track provider attendance records
- Frustrations: no platform that handles recurring multi-property scheduling; manually coordinates each visit via phone calls

### 1.3 Feature List

| Priority | Feature | Description | Success Metric |
|---|---|---|---|
| P0 | Phone OTP auth | Termii-powered phone verification; no email required | Auth completion rate > 90% |
| P0 | Provider search + map | PostGIS ST_DWithin radius search by category + location | Search p95 < 400ms |
| P0 | Slot booking with deposit | SORF hold + 30% Paystack deposit to confirm | Deposit conversion > 65% |
| P0 | Real-time GPS tracking | Provider location shared with customer from dispatch to arrival | GPS accuracy ≤ 30m |
| P0 | Before/after photo evidence | Provider uploads photos on job start and completion | Photo upload success > 95% |
| P0 | Paystack HMAC webhook | Confirm booking on charge.success; cancel on charge.failed | Webhook p99 < 2s |
| P0 | Background check gate | Provider cannot go live until background_check_status = 'passed' | 100% compliance |
| P1 | In-app chat | Customer ↔ provider messaging after booking confirmed | First reply < 5 min |
| P1 | Loyalty points | 1 point per ₦1 spent; 500 points = ₦500 off next booking | Repeat booking rate +20% |
| P1 | Recurring bookings | Weekly/fortnightly recurring jobs; customer sets RRULE | Recurring share > 30% of bookings |
| P1 | Service quote flow | Providers submit quote for large jobs (painting, renovation) before deposit | Quote acceptance > 55% |
| P1 | Rating + review | 5-star rating post-completion; review visible on provider profile | Rating submission rate > 60% |
| P1 | Waitlist | Customer joins waitlist if preferred provider is booked; auto-notified on cancellation | Waitlist conversion > 40% |
| P2 | Property Manager dashboard | Multi-property recurring schedule, per-property invoice export | Property Manager NPS > 60 |
| P2 | AI no-show prediction | Flag bookings with >60% no-show risk; require same-day confirmation | No-show rate < 8% |
| P2 | USSD status check | Providers check today's jobs and earnings via `*396*HOMEPRO#` on feature phones | USSD MAU > 5k |

### 1.4 Non-Functional Requirements

| Requirement | Target |
|---|---|
| API response time (p95) | < 300ms |
| Uptime | 99.5% |
| Mobile app cold start | < 3s on mid-range Android |
| Max concurrent users (MVP) | 1,500 |
| GPS ping frequency | Every 30 seconds while job is active |
| Photo upload (5 MB max) | < 8s on 3G |
| Data residency | Nigeria (Supabase region: ap-southeast-1 closest available) |

### 2.2 Service Inventory

| Service | Provider | Purpose | Auth Method |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile App | Expo SDK 51 | Customer + provider apps | Supabase JWT |
| Web Dashboard | Next.js 14 | Admin + Property Manager portal | Supabase JWT |
| Auth | Supabase Auth | JWT issuance, session management | Supabase internal |
| OTP Delivery | Termii | Phone OTP via SMS | TERMII_API_KEY |
| Database | Supabase Postgres 15 | Primary data store | Service role key (server only) |
| Edge Functions | Supabase Deno | API logic, webhooks, USSD | Bearer JWT / service role |
| File Storage | Supabase Storage | Job photo evidence, profile photos | Signed URLs (private bucket) |
| Realtime | Supabase Realtime | Live GPS channel, job status | Anon key (row-level filtered) |
| Payment Processing | Paystack | Deposit + balance charges, split payouts | PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY |
| SMS Notifications | Termii | Booking confirmations, reminders, OTP | TERMII_API_KEY |
| USSD | Africa's Talking | Feature-phone provider job/earnings check | AT_API_KEY |
| Maps | Google Maps API | Geocoding, provider distance sort | GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY |
| pg_cron | Supabase pg_cron | Hold expiry, reminders, KPI refresh, no-show check | Internal Postgres |

### 2.3 Data Flow Narratives

**Flow 1 — Customer Registration (Phone OTP)**
1. Customer enters phone number → POST `/send-otp` → Termii `send-otp` endpoint → OTP SMS delivered
2. Customer enters 6-digit OTP → POST `/verify-otp` → Supabase Auth `verifyOtp` → JWT returned with `{ tenant_id, role: 'customer' }`
3. `customer_profiles` row created if first login; `loyalty_accounts` row created with `points_balance = 0`

**Flow 2 — Book a Plumber (SORF Hold → Deposit)**
1. Customer searches "plumber" near coordinates → GET `/search-providers` → PostGIS `ST_DWithin` query → providers returned ordered by distance + rating
2. Customer selects provider, service, date/time → POST `/book-slot`
   - Validates `availability_windows` for that day_of_week + time
   - Checks `availability_overrides` for one-off blocks
   - Inserts `bookings` row with `status='held'`, `held_until=+15min` (triggers `EXCLUDE USING gist` check)
   - Computes deposit (30% of `services.price_kobo` from `businesses.deposit_policy`)
   - Calls Paystack `/transaction/initialize` → returns `authorization_url`
3. Customer completes payment on Paystack redirect
4. Paystack fires `charge.success` webhook → POST `/paystack-webhook`
   - HMAC-SHA-512 verified against `x-paystack-signature`
   - Booking transitions `held → confirmed`; `deposit_paid = true`
   - Reminder `automation_jobs` created (24h + 2h before `starts_at`)
   - Loyalty points queued (idempotent)
   - Termii SMS sent to customer + provider

**Flow 3 — Provider GPS Dispatch**
1. Provider opens app on day of job → status updated to `dispatched`
2. Provider starts GPS broadcast → `expo-location` watchPosition → POST `/gps-ping` every 30s → insert `gps_pings` row
3. Supabase Realtime channel `gps:{booking_id}` pushes location to customer app
4. Provider taps "Arrived" → booking status → `checked_in`; customer notified
5. Provider taps "Start Job" → status → `in_progress`; provider uploads before-photo to `job-evidence` bucket
6. Provider taps "Complete Job" → uploads after-photo → status → `completed`
7. Remaining balance charged via Paystack; provider payout queued

**Flow 4 — Paystack Webhook (HMAC verification)**
1. Paystack POST to `/paystack-webhook` with `x-paystack-signature` (SHA-512 of raw body using secret key)
2. Edge Function reads raw body text (not parsed JSON) → computes HMAC → compares to header
3. If mismatch → return 401; if match → parse event
4. `charge.success` → booking `held → confirmed`, loyalty credited, reminders queued
5. `charge.failed` → booking `held → cancelled`, DB trigger fires `notify_waitlist` automatically

## SECTION 3 — Full SQL Schema

```sql
-- ── Extensions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pgcrypto";
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pg_trgm";
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "postgis";
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pg_cron";
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "btree_gist";

-- ── Enums ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TYPE booking_status AS ENUM (
  'pending', 'confirmed', 'held', 'checked_in', 'in_progress',
  'completed', 'cancelled', 'no_show', 'disputed'
);

CREATE TYPE background_check_status AS ENUM ('pending', 'in_review', 'passed', 'failed');
CREATE TYPE job_photo_type    AS ENUM ('before', 'after', 'damage', 'access_issue');
CREATE TYPE payment_status    AS ENUM ('pending', 'completed', 'failed', 'refunded');
CREATE TYPE quote_status      AS ENUM ('pending', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'expired');
CREATE TYPE user_role         AS ENUM ('customer', 'provider', 'branch_manager', 'franchise_owner', 'super_admin');
CREATE TYPE deposit_status    AS ENUM ('held', 'applied', 'refunded');

-- ── Helper Functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION current_user_tenant_id()
RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::jsonb ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid,
    NULL
  );
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at()
RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_super_admin()
RETURNS bool LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::jsonb ->> 'role') = 'super_admin',
    false
  );
$$;

-- ── Core Tables ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE tenants (
  id         uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL,
  slug       text UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TRIGGER tenants_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON tenants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE users (
  id           uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id    uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
  phone        text NOT NULL,
  role         user_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'customer',
  push_token   text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT users_phone_tenant_unique UNIQUE (phone, tenant_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_users_tenant ON users(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_users_phone  ON users(phone);
CREATE TRIGGER users_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

ALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY users_tenant_isolation ON users
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

-- ── Profile Tables ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE customer_profiles (
  id                  uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id             uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  tenant_id           uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
  display_name        text,
  no_show_count       int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  require_prepayment  bool NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  address_text        text,
  location            geography(POINT, 4326),
  created_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_profiles_user_unique UNIQUE (user_id, tenant_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_customer_profiles_user ON customer_profiles(user_id);
CREATE TRIGGER customer_profiles_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON customer_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
ALTER TABLE customer_profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY customer_profiles_isolation ON customer_profiles
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

CREATE TABLE provider_profiles (
  id                      uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id                 uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  tenant_id               uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
  display_name            text NOT NULL,
  bio                     text,
  background_check_status background_check_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  background_check_date   date,
  service_categories      text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  service_radius_km       int NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
  years_experience        int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  rating_avg              numeric(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  rating_count            int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  location                geography(POINT, 4326),
  is_active               bool NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- true only when background_check_status = 'passed'
  payout_account_code     text,  -- Paystack recipient code for provider payouts
  created_at              timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at              timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT provider_profiles_user_unique UNIQUE (user_id, tenant_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_provider_profiles_location ON provider_profiles USING gist(location);
CREATE INDEX idx_provider_profiles_tenant   ON provider_profiles(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_provider_profiles_bg_check ON provider_profiles(background_check_status);
CREATE TRIGGER provider_profiles_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON provider_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
ALTER TABLE provider_profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY provider_profiles_isolation ON provider_profiles
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

-- ── Business / Branch Hierarchy ───────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE businesses (
  id                   uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,

  cancellation_policy  jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"free_before_hours":4,"penalty_percentage":50}',
  no_show_policy       jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"strikes_before_prepayment":3,"prepayment_type":"full"}',
  quote_threshold_kobo bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 5000000, -- require quote for jobs > ₦50,000

);
CREATE INDEX idx_businesses_tenant ON businesses(tenant_id);
CREATE TRIGGER businesses_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON businesses FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
ALTER TABLE businesses ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

CREATE TABLE branches (

CREATE TRIGGER branches_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON branches FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
ALTER TABLE branches ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY branches_isolation ON branches
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

-- staff = service providers, one row per provider-branch assignment
CREATE TABLE staff (
  id           uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,

CREATE INDEX idx_staff_branch  ON staff(branch_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_staff_tenant  ON staff(tenant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_staff_user    ON staff(user_id);
CREATE TRIGGER staff_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON staff FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
ALTER TABLE staff ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY staff_isolation ON staff
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

CREATE TABLE services (
  id               uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,

CREATE POLICY services_isolation ON services
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

-- ── Availability ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE availability_windows (

ALTER TABLE availability_overrides ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

-- ── Bookings (SORF Core) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE bookings (
  id                   uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id            uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
  branch_id            uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES branches(id),
  staff_id             uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES staff(id),
  service_id           uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES services(id),
  customer_id          uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  status               booking_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  starts_at            timestamptz NOT NULL,
  ends_at              timestamptz NOT NULL,
  held_until           timestamptz,
  deposit_paid         bool NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  deposit_amount_kobo  bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_amount_kobo    bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  balance_amount_kobo  bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS (total_amount_kobo - deposit_amount_kobo) STORED,
  balance_paid         bool NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  recurrence_rule      text,   -- RRULE string for recurring bookings
  customer_address     text,
  customer_location    geography(POINT, 4326),
  notes                text,
  no_show_probability  numeric(3,2),
  confirmed_at         timestamptz,
  checked_in_at        timestamptz,
  started_at           timestamptz,
  completed_at         timestamptz,
  cancelled_at         timestamptz,
  cancellation_reason  text,
  created_at           timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at           timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  -- SORF: Prevent provider double-booking at DB level
  -- Cancelled/disputed bookings excluded from constraint
  EXCLUDE USING gist (
    staff_id WITH =,
    branch_id WITH =,
    tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at, '[)') WITH &&
  ) WHERE (status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'disputed'))
);
CREATE INDEX idx_bookings_staff      ON bookings(staff_id, starts_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_bookings_customer   ON bookings(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_bookings_status     ON bookings(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_bookings_held_until ON bookings(held_until) WHERE status = 'held';
CREATE INDEX idx_bookings_starts_at  ON bookings(starts_at);
CREATE TRIGGER bookings_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON bookings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
ALTER TABLE bookings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY bookings_isolation ON bookings
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

CREATE INDEX idx_waitlist_staff_service ON waitlist_entries(staff_id, service_id);
ALTER TABLE waitlist_entries ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

-- Trigger: notify_waitlist when a booking is cancelled or marked no_show
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION notify_waitlist()
RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status IN ('cancelled', 'no_show') AND OLD.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show') THEN
    INSERT INTO automation_jobs (job_type, payload, idempotency_key, run_at)
    VALUES (
      'waitlist_notify',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'staff_id',   NEW.staff_id,
        'service_id', NEW.service_id,
        'date',       NEW.starts_at::date
      ),
      'waitlist-notify-' || NEW.id || '-' || NEW.status,
      now()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER bookings_notify_waitlist
  AFTER UPDATE OF status ON bookings
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_waitlist();

-- ── Loyalty ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE loyalty_accounts (
  id             uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id      uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
  customer_id    uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  points_balance int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  tier           text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard' CHECK (tier IN ('standard','silver','gold','platinum')),
  lifetime_kobo  bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT loyalty_accounts_customer_unique UNIQUE (customer_id, tenant_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_loyalty_accounts_customer ON loyalty_accounts(customer_id);
CREATE TRIGGER loyalty_accounts_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON loyalty_accounts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
ALTER TABLE loyalty_accounts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY loyalty_accounts_isolation ON loyalty_accounts
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

CREATE TABLE loyalty_transactions (
  id                  uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id           uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
  customer_id         uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  loyalty_account_id  uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES loyalty_accounts(id),
  booking_id          uuid REFERENCES bookings(id),
  points              int NOT NULL,
  transaction_type    text NOT NULL CHECK (transaction_type IN ('earn','redeem','adjustment','expire')),
  description         text,
  idempotency_key     text UNIQUE,
  created_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_loyalty_tx_account ON loyalty_transactions(loyalty_account_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_loyalty_tx_booking ON loyalty_transactions(booking_id);
ALTER TABLE loyalty_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY loyalty_tx_isolation ON loyalty_transactions
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

-- ── Home Services — Specialty Tables ─────────────────────────────────────────
-- GPS pings — append-only
CREATE TABLE gps_pings (
  id          uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id   uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
  booking_id  uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id),
  provider_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  location    geography(POINT, 4326) NOT NULL,
  accuracy_m  numeric(6,1),
  recorded_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  synced_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CHECK (recorded_at <= now() + interval '5 seconds')  -- prevent future timestamps
);
CREATE INDEX idx_gps_pings_booking    ON gps_pings(booking_id, recorded_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_gps_pings_location   ON gps_pings USING gist(location);
ALTER TABLE gps_pings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY gps_pings_isolation ON gps_pings
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

-- Job photos — before/after evidence
CREATE TABLE job_photos (
  id           uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id    uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
  booking_id   uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id),
  photo_type   job_photo_type NOT NULL,
  storage_path text NOT NULL,
  uploaded_by  uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  synced_at    timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_job_photos_booking ON job_photos(booking_id, photo_type);
ALTER TABLE job_photos ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY job_photos_isolation ON job_photos
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

-- Service quotes for large jobs (> businesses.quote_threshold_kobo)
CREATE TABLE service_quotes (
  id           uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id    uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
  booking_id   uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id),
  staff_id     uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES staff(id),
  amount_kobo  bigint NOT NULL,
  valid_until  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now() + interval '24 hours'),
  status       quote_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  notes        text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_service_quotes_booking ON service_quotes(booking_id, status);
CREATE TRIGGER service_quotes_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON service_quotes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
ALTER TABLE service_quotes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY service_quotes_isolation ON service_quotes
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

-- ── Payments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE payment_transactions (
  id               uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id        uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
  booking_id       uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id),
  customer_id      uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  provider         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'paystack',
  provider_ref     text,
  provider_payload jsonb,
  amount_kobo      bigint NOT NULL,
  currency         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NGN',
  status           payment_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  is_deposit       bool NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  idempotency_key  text UNIQUE,
  created_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_payment_tx_booking ON payment_transactions(booking_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_payment_tx_ref     ON payment_transactions(provider_ref);
CREATE TRIGGER payment_tx_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_transactions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
ALTER TABLE payment_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY payment_tx_isolation ON payment_transactions
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

-- Cash payment tracking (for customers who pay cash to provider)
CREATE TABLE cash_payments (
  id            uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id     uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id),
  booking_id    uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id),
  amount_kobo   bigint NOT NULL,
  collected_by  uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),  -- provider who received cash
  confirmed_at  timestamptz,
  notes         text,
  created_at    timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_cash_payments_booking ON cash_payments(booking_id);
ALTER TABLE cash_payments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY cash_payments_isolation ON cash_payments
  USING (tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id() OR is_super_admin());

-- ── Automation and Audit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE automation_jobs (
  id               uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id        uuid REFERENCES tenants(id),
  job_type         text NOT NULL,
  payload          jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  status           text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','running','completed','failed','dead')),
  idempotency_key  text UNIQUE,
  attempts         int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  max_attempts     int NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
  run_at           timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  last_error       text,
  created_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_automation_jobs_pending ON automation_jobs(run_at) WHERE status = 'pending';
CREATE TRIGGER automation_jobs_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON automation_jobs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
  id          uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id   uuid REFERENCES tenants(id),
  actor_id    uuid,
  action      text NOT NULL,
  table_name  text,
  record_id   uuid,
  old_data    jsonb,
  new_data    jsonb,
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_logs_record ON audit_logs(table_name, record_id);
ALTER TABLE audit_logs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY audit_logs_admin_only ON audit_logs
  USING (is_super_admin() OR tenant_id = current_user_tenant_id());

CREATE TABLE phone_otps (
  id         uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  phone      text NOT NULL,
  code_hash  text NOT NULL,  -- bcrypt hash of 6-digit OTP
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now() + interval '10 minutes'),
  used_at    timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_phone_otps_phone ON phone_otps(phone, expires_at DESC);

-- ── USSD Sessions (Africa's Talking) ─────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE ussd_sessions (
  id           uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id   text NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- Africa's Talking sessionId
  phone        text NOT NULL,
  menu_state   text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'main',
  last_input   text,
  expires_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now() + interval '5 minutes'),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_ussd_sessions_phone ON ussd_sessions(phone);
CREATE TRIGGER ussd_sessions_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON ussd_sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

-- ── Branch KPIs (materialised view) ──────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW branch_kpis AS
SELECT
  b.id                                                     AS branch_id,
  b.name                                                   AS branch_name,
  b.city,
  COUNT(bk.id) FILTER (WHERE bk.status = 'completed')     AS completed_jobs,
  COUNT(bk.id) FILTER (WHERE bk.status = 'no_show')       AS no_shows,
  COUNT(bk.id) FILTER (WHERE bk.status = 'cancelled')     AS cancellations,
  COUNT(bk.id) FILTER (WHERE bk.status IN ('completed', 'no_show', 'cancelled', 'confirmed'))
                                                           AS total_bookings,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(bk.id) FILTER (WHERE bk.status = 'completed')::numeric /
    NULLIF(COUNT(bk.id) FILTER (WHERE bk.status IN ('completed','no_show')),0) * 100,
    1
  )                                                        AS completion_rate_pct,
  SUM(bk.total_amount_kobo) FILTER (WHERE bk.status = 'completed')
                                                           AS gmv_kobo,
  AVG(pp.rating_avg) FILTER (WHERE pp.is_active = true)   AS avg_provider_rating,
  now()                                                    AS refreshed_at
FROM branches b
LEFT JOIN bookings bk  ON bk.branch_id = b.id AND bk.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
LEFT JOIN staff s      ON s.branch_id = b.id
LEFT JOIN provider_profiles pp ON pp.id = s.provider_id
GROUP BY b.id, b.name, b.city;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_branch_kpis_id ON branch_kpis(branch_id);

-- Refresh branch_kpis every 15 minutes
SELECT cron.schedule('refresh-branch-kpis', '*/15 * * * *',
  'REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY branch_kpis;');
```

## SECTION 4 — API Definitions

### Auth

```
POST /functions/v1/send-otp
Auth: none
Description: Send 6-digit OTP via Termii to phone number

Request:
{
  "phone": string  // E.164 format: +2348012345678
}

Response 200:
{
  "success": true,
  "expires_in": 600   // seconds
}

Errors:
- 422: invalid phone format
- 429: rate limit — max 3 OTPs per phone per 10 minutes
```

```
POST /functions/v1/verify-otp
Auth: none
Description: Verify OTP, return Supabase JWT with tenant_id + role

Request:
{
  "phone": string,
  "otp":   string  // 6-digit code
}

Response 200:
{
  "access_token":  string,
  "refresh_token": string,
  "user_id":       string,
  "role":          "customer" | "provider"
}

Errors:
- 401: invalid or expired OTP
- 429: too many attempts (5 max per code)
```

### Provider Search & Discovery

```
GET /functions/v1/search-providers
Auth: bearer (customer)
Description: Find providers by category near customer location (PostGIS ST_DWithin)

Query params:
  category     string   required — "cleaning" | "plumbing" | "electrical" | etc.
  lat          number   required
  lng          number   required
  radius_km    number   default 15
  date         string   ISO 8601 date — filter by availability on this day
  page         number   default 1, page size 20

Response 200:
{
  "providers": [
    {
      "provider_id":       string,
      "display_name":      string,
      "rating_avg":        number,
      "rating_count":      number,
      "distance_km":       number,
      "services":          [{ "id": string, "name": string, "price_kobo": number, "duration_minutes": number }],
      "next_available_at": string  // ISO 8601
    }
  ],
  "total": number
}

Errors:
- 422: missing required query params
```

### Booking

```
POST /functions/v1/book-slot
Auth: bearer (customer)
Description: Create SORF held booking + initialise Paystack deposit

Request:
{
  "staff_id":          string,
  "service_id":        string,
  "branch_id":         string,
  "starts_at":         string,  // ISO 8601 future datetime
  "customer_address":  string,
  "customer_location": { "lat": number, "lng": number },
  "notes":             string   // optional
}

Response 200:
{
  "success":              true,
  "booking_id":           string,
  "held_until":           string,  // ISO 8601 — 15 min from now
  "deposit_amount_kobo":  number,
  "total_amount_kobo":    number,
  "paystack_init_url":    string,
  "paystack_reference":   string
}

Errors:
- 401: missing / invalid JWT
- 403: tenant_id missing from token
- 404: service or staff not found
- 409: slot_taken — EXCLUDE gist violation (concurrent booking)
- 422: starts_at in the past, or staff unavailable on this day/time
```

```
PATCH /functions/v1/bookings/:id/status
Auth: bearer (provider or customer depending on transition)
Description: Advance SORF booking status. Allowed transitions:
  provider: held→cancelled, confirmed→dispatched, dispatched→checked_in,
            checked_in→in_progress, in_progress→completed, confirmed→no_show
  customer: confirmed→cancelled, any→disputed

Request:
{
  "status":              string,
  "cancellation_reason": string  // required when status=cancelled
}

Response 200:
{
  "success":    true,
  "booking_id": string,
  "status":     string
}

Errors:
- 403: transition not allowed for this role
- 404: booking not found
- 422: invalid status transition
```

### GPS Tracking

```
POST /functions/v1/gps-ping
Auth: bearer (provider)
Description: Record provider GPS location during active job (called every 30s)

Request:
{
  "booking_id": string,
  "lat":        number,
  "lng":        number,
  "accuracy_m": number  // GPS accuracy in metres
}

Response 200:
{
  "success": true
}

Errors:
- 403: provider not assigned to this booking
- 422: booking not in dispatched/checked_in/in_progress status
```

### Job Photos

```
POST /functions/v1/job-photos
Auth: bearer (provider)
Description: Get signed upload URL for job evidence photo

Request:
{
  "booking_id": string,
  "photo_type": "before" | "after" | "damage" | "access_issue"
}

Response 200:
{
  "upload_url":    string,  // Supabase Storage signed upload URL (60s TTL)
  "storage_path":  string   // path to store in job_photos after upload
}

Errors:
- 403: provider not assigned to this booking
- 422: invalid photo_type
```

### Payments Webhook

```
POST /functions/v1/paystack-webhook
Auth: x-paystack-signature (HMAC-SHA-512)
Description: Handle Paystack charge.success / charge.failed events

Events handled:
  charge.success — booking held→confirmed, loyalty credited, reminders queued
  charge.failed  — booking held→cancelled, waitlist notified (via DB trigger)
  (all other events acknowledged with { "success": true, "ignored": true })

Response 200:
{
  "success":    true,
  "booking_id": string,
  "status":     "confirmed" | "cancelled" | "not_held" | "already_processed"
}
```

### Loyalty

```
GET /functions/v1/loyalty/balance
Auth: bearer (customer)
Description: Return current loyalty balance and tier

Response 200:
{
  "points_balance": number,
  "tier":           "standard" | "silver" | "gold" | "platinum",
  "lifetime_kobo":  number,
  "recent_transactions": [
    {
      "points":           number,
      "transaction_type": string,
      "description":      string,
      "created_at":       string
    }
  ]
}
```

### Branch KPIs

```
GET /functions/v1/branch-kpis
Auth: bearer (branch_manager or franchise_owner or super_admin)
Description: Return KPI snapshot from branch_kpis materialised view

Response 200:
{
  "branches": [
    {
      "branch_id":           string,
      "branch_name":         string,
      "city":                string,
      "completed_jobs":      number,
      "no_shows":            number,
      "completion_rate_pct": number,
      "gmv_kobo":            number,
      "avg_provider_rating": number,
      "refreshed_at":        string
    }
  ]
}
```

### Offline Sync

```
POST /functions/v1/offline-flush
Auth: bearer (provider)
Description: Batch-insert GPS pings accumulated offline in expo-sqlite

Request:
{
  "pings": [
    {
      "booking_id":  string,
      "lat":         number,
      "lng":         number,
      "accuracy_m":  number,
      "recorded_at": string  // ISO 8601 — original timestamp on device
    }
  ]
}

Response 200:
{
  "inserted": number,
  "skipped":  number   // already present by (booking_id, recorded_at)
}
```

## SECTION 7 — Automation Engine

### 7.1 Event Catalogue

| Event Name | Trigger | Handler Action | Idempotency Key Pattern |
|---|---|---|---|
| `booking.held` | Booking inserted with `status='held'` | Log audit entry; start 15-min expiry timer | `booking-{id}-held` |
| `booking.confirmed` | Paystack `charge.success` webhook | SMS customer + provider (Termii); push notification; queue 24h + 2h reminder jobs | `booking-{id}-confirmed` |
| `booking.dispatched` | Provider taps "On My Way" | Push to customer: "Provider is on their way"; start GPS channel | `booking-{id}-dispatched` |
| `booking.checked_in` | Provider taps "Arrived" | Push to customer: "Provider arrived at [time]"; start job timer | `booking-{id}-checkin` |
| `booking.in_progress` | Provider taps "Start Job" | Push to customer: "Job started"; before-photo upload triggered | `booking-{id}-started` |
| `booking.completed` | Provider taps "Job Complete" + after-photo uploaded | Charge balance via Paystack; credit loyalty points; enqueue rating SMS (30-min delay); stop GPS channel | `booking-{id}-completed` |
| `booking.cancelled` | Status → `cancelled` | Evaluate refund: free if > 4h before start, 50% penalty otherwise; notify waitlist (DB trigger) | `booking-{id}-cancelled` |
| `booking.no_show` | pg_cron: no check-in 30+ min post-starts_at | Increment `no_show_count`; if ≥ 3, set `require_prepayment=true`; notify branch manager | `booking-{id}-no-show` |
| `booking.disputed` | Customer raises dispute | Freeze provider payout; create dispute record; notify admin | `booking-{id}-disputed` |
| `payment.confirmed` | Paystack `charge.success` | Same as `booking.confirmed` path in confirm-payment function | `paystack-{reference}` |
| `payment.failed` | Paystack `charge.failed` | Cancel booking; notify customer with retry link; waitlist triggered by DB | `paystack-{reference}-fail` |
| `waitlist.notified` | DB trigger on cancellation/no_show | Query next waitlist entry for same staff_id + service; send SMS with 30-min acceptance window | `waitlist-{entry-id}-notify` |
| `loyalty.credited` | `booking.completed` | Insert `loyalty_transactions` row (idempotent); check tier upgrade; send SMS if tier upgraded | `loyalty-{booking-id}-earn` |
| `reminder.24h` | pg_cron at exact time (from automation_jobs) | SMS + push: "Your HomePro booking is tomorrow at [time]" | `reminder-{booking-id}-24h` |
| `reminder.2h` | pg_cron at exact time (from automation_jobs) | SMS: "Your provider [name] is coming in 2 hours. Address: [customer_address]" | `reminder-{booking-id}-2h` |
| `ai.noshow_risk` | Daily pg_cron at 21:00 WAT | Score next-day bookings; flag risk > 60%; SMS branch manager alert | `ai-noshow-{date}-{booking-id}` |
| `ai.rebook_nudge` | 14 days after `booking.completed` (default per category) | WhatsApp message: "Hi [name], it's time to book your next [service] with [provider]" | `rebook-{customer-id}-{service-id}` |
| `gps.channel_closed` | `booking.completed` or `booking.cancelled` | Supabase Realtime: unsubscribe GPS channel for this booking | `gps-close-{booking-id}` |

### 7.2 Jobs Table
Defined in Section 3 (`automation_jobs`). Uses `idempotency_key UNIQUE` constraint — all inserts use `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` or `.insert().select()`.

### 7.3 Retry Logic
- Attempt 1: immediate
- Attempt 2: +5 min
- Attempt 3: +30 min
- After `max_attempts`: status = 'dead'; Termii SMS alert to admin `+2348012345678` (configured via `ADMIN_PHONE` env var)

### 7.4 pg_cron Jobs

```sql
-- Process pending automation_jobs every 1 minute
SELECT cron.schedule('process-jobs', '* * * * *',
  $$SELECT process_pending_jobs()$$);

-- Expire stale held bookings (past held_until)
SELECT cron.schedule('expire-held-bookings', '*/5 * * * *', $$
  UPDATE bookings
  SET status = 'cancelled', cancellation_reason = 'hold_expired', cancelled_at = now()
  WHERE status = 'held' AND held_until < now();
$$);

-- Mark no-shows: booking confirmed but no check-in 30+ minutes after starts_at
SELECT cron.schedule('mark-no-shows', '*/15 * * * *', $$
  UPDATE bookings
  SET status = 'no_show'
  WHERE status = 'confirmed'
    AND starts_at < now() - interval '30 minutes'
    AND checked_in_at IS NULL;
$$);

-- Refresh branch_kpis every 15 minutes (defined in Section 3)
-- Already registered above.

-- AI no-show risk scoring — daily at 21:00 WAT (20:00 UTC)
SELECT cron.schedule('ai-noshow-scoring', '0 20 * * *', $$
  INSERT INTO automation_jobs (job_type, payload, idempotency_key, run_at)
  SELECT 'ai_noshow_score',
         jsonb_build_object('booking_id', id, 'date', starts_at::date),
         'ai-noshow-' || starts_at::date || '-' || id,
         now()
  FROM bookings
  WHERE status = 'confirmed'
    AND starts_at::date = CURRENT_DATE + 1
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
$$);

-- Re-booking nudge — daily at 09:00 WAT (08:00 UTC)
SELECT cron.schedule('rebook-nudges', '0 8 * * *', $$
  INSERT INTO automation_jobs (job_type, payload, idempotency_key, run_at)
  SELECT 'rebook_nudge',
         jsonb_build_object('customer_id', customer_id, 'service_id', service_id, 'booking_id', id),
         'rebook-' || customer_id || '-' || service_id,
         now()
  FROM bookings
  WHERE status = 'completed'
    AND completed_at::date = CURRENT_DATE - 14
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
$$);
```

### 7.5 Webhook Security

Every payment webhook handler (Paystack):
1. Read raw body text before any JSON parsing
2. Compute HMAC-SHA-512 of raw body using `PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY`
3. Compare hex digest to `x-paystack-signature` header — reject with 401 on mismatch
4. Return 200 on all events after signature verification (including unhandled events) — prevents Paystack retry storms
5. Log raw payload to `audit_logs` with `action = 'webhook.received'` before processing

## SECTION 8 — Deployment Plan

### 8.1 Prerequisites

| Account | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Supabase (supabase.com) | Database, Auth, Edge Functions, Storage, Realtime |
| Paystack (paystack.com) | Payment processing; enable Split Payments for provider payouts |
| Termii (termii.com) | Phone OTP + booking SMS |
| Africa's Talking (africastalking.com) | USSD fallback for feature-phone providers |
| Google Cloud Console | Maps API (geocoding + Distance Matrix) |
| Vercel (vercel.com) | Next.js web dashboard hosting |
| Expo / EAS (expo.dev) | Expo build + OTA updates |
| GitHub | Source code + GitHub Actions CI/CD |

### 8.2 Step-by-Step Setup

**Step 1 — Supabase project**
1. Create project at supabase.com → choose region (ap-southeast-1) → name "homepro-ng-prod"
2. Settings → Database → Enable pg_cron extension
3. Settings → Database → Enable PostGIS: run `CREATE EXTENSION postgis;`
4. Settings → Auth → Disable email + disable magic link; enable Phone provider
5. Settings → API → copy URL and keys to `.env`

**Step 2 — Run migrations**
```bash
supabase login
supabase link --project-ref <project-ref>
supabase db push
```

**Step 3 — Create Supabase Storage buckets**
1. Storage → New bucket: `job-evidence` → Private (not public)
2. Storage → New bucket: `profile-photos` → Public
3. Add storage policy to `job-evidence`: only authenticated users with `provider` role can upload to their own path

**Step 4 — Deploy Edge Functions**
```bash
supabase functions deploy send-otp
supabase functions deploy verify-otp
supabase functions deploy book-slot
supabase functions deploy paystack-webhook
supabase functions deploy gps-ping
supabase functions deploy offline-flush
supabase functions deploy job-photos
supabase functions deploy patch-booking
supabase functions deploy loyalty-balance
supabase functions deploy branch-kpis
supabase functions deploy ussd-handler
```

**Step 5 — Paystack webhook registration**
1. Paystack dashboard → Settings → Webhooks → Add URL: `https://<supabase-project>.supabase.co/functions/v1/paystack-webhook`
2. Enable events: `charge.success`, `charge.failed`

**Step 6 — Africa's Talking USSD channel**
1. AT dashboard → USSD → Create channel: service code `*396*HOMEPRO#` (registered with NCC)
2. Callback URL: `https://<supabase-project>.supabase.co/functions/v1/ussd-handler`

**Step 7 — Deploy web dashboard**
```bash
vercel --prod
# Set all env vars in Vercel dashboard (Settings → Environment Variables)
```

**Step 8 — Build and submit mobile app**
```bash
eas build --platform android --profile production
eas submit --platform android
```

### 8.4 CI/CD Spec

**`.github/workflows/ci.yml`** — triggers on push to `main` and on PRs:

```yaml
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint-typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '20', cache: 'npm' }
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run typecheck

  deploy-staging:
    needs: lint-typecheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1
      - run: supabase db push --project-ref ${{ secrets.STAGING_SUPABASE_REF }}
      - run: supabase functions deploy --project-ref ${{ secrets.STAGING_SUPABASE_REF }}
      - run: vercel --token ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }} --env NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=${{ secrets.STAGING_SUPABASE_URL }}
```

**`.github/workflows/release.yml`** — triggers on version tags `v*`:

```yaml
name: Release
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']

jobs:
  migrate-production:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1
      - run: supabase db push --project-ref ${{ secrets.PROD_SUPABASE_REF }}
      - run: supabase functions deploy --project-ref ${{ secrets.PROD_SUPABASE_REF }}

  deploy-web-production:
    needs: migrate-production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: vercel --prod --token ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}

  build-mobile:
    needs: migrate-production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: expo/expo-github-action@v8
        with: { expo-version: latest, eas-version: latest, token: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }} }
      - run: eas build --platform android --profile production --non-interactive
      - run: eas submit --platform android --non-interactive
```

## SECTION 9 — Monetization Strategy

### 9.1 Revenue Model

| Stream | Model | Rate | Implementation | Projected MRR at 500 jobs/day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Platform fee | % of transaction value | 15% of job value | Paystack split: 85% to provider recipient code, 15% retained | ₦3.4M |
| Pro Provider subscription | Monthly SaaS | ₦8,000/month | Paystack Recurring plan `HOMEPRO_PRO`; stores `paystack_sub_code` on `provider_subscriptions` | ₦1.2M (150 Pro providers) |
| Featured provider boost | Weekly listing fee | ₦5,000/week | `is_featured bool` + `featured_until timestamptz` on `provider_profiles`; pg_cron expires daily | ₦400k (80 boosts/week avg) |
| Background check fee | One-time per provider | ₦3,500/provider | Paystack one-time charge on `provider onboarding` completion | ₦175k (50 new providers/month) |
| Property Manager plan | Monthly SaaS | ₦25,000/month | Paystack Recurring plan `HOMEPRO_PM`; unlimited bookings + invoice export | ₦750k (30 property managers) |

**Total projected MRR: ₦5.9M at 500 jobs/day across Lagos + Abuja**

### 9.2 Pricing Tiers

| Tier | Price (monthly) | Inclusions | Target Segment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free Provider | ₦0 | Up to 20 bookings/month, standard placement, 15% platform fee | New / low-volume providers |
| Pro Provider | ₦8,000 | Unlimited bookings, 5 free weekly boosts, priority dispatch queue, 12% platform fee, analytics dashboard | Established professionals (10+ jobs/month) |
| Property Manager | ₦25,000 | Unlimited properties, recurring scheduler, invoice PDF export, dedicated account manager | Facilities managers, estate agents, Airbnb hosts |

### 9.3 Fee Structure

- Platform fee: 15% of total job value (Free providers), 12% (Pro providers)
- Paystack processing fee: ~1.5% NGN — borne by platform
- Net platform margin: ~13.5% (Free) / ~10.5% (Pro)
- Provider receives: 85% (Free) / 88% (Pro) via Paystack split payment to recipient code

### 9.4 Featured Listings

- Featured provider slot: ₦5,000/week
- Placement: appears first in category search results within their city
- Implementation: `is_featured bool DEFAULT false` + `featured_until timestamptz` on `provider_profiles`
- pg_cron job runs daily at midnight WAT to set `is_featured = false` where `featured_until < now()`
- Maximum 10 featured providers per category per city to preserve exclusivity

## SECTION 10 — Scaling Plan

### 10.1 0 → 10,000 Users

| Action | Trigger | Implementation |
|---|---|---|
| Enable pgBouncer | > 50 concurrent users | Supabase → Database → Connection Pooling → Transaction mode |
| Index GPS pings by booking + time | GPS ping p95 > 100ms | `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_gps_booking_time ON gps_pings(booking_id, recorded_at DESC)` |
| Supabase Realtime channel limits | > 200 concurrent GPS channels | Set `max_channels` in Supabase Realtime config; upgrade to Pro plan (200 concurrent channels) |
| AI no-show v1 (rule-based) | At launch | Flag: `no_show_count >= 3` OR `starts_at within 2 hours of booking creation`; no ML model needed |
| Cloudflare CDN for profile photos | > 500 daily active users | Add `profile-photos` bucket behind Cloudflare; set 7-day cache-control |
| Supabase Storage presigned URL TTL | Storage abuse detected | Reduce upload URL TTL from 60s to 30s |

### 10.2 10,000 → 100,000 Users

| Action | Trigger | Implementation |
|---|---|---|
| Partition `gps_pings` by month | Table > 50M rows | `PARTITION BY RANGE (recorded_at)`; monthly partitions; auto-drop pings older than 90 days |
| Separate GPS channel service | Realtime latency > 500ms | Dedicated Ably or Pusher channel for GPS (lower latency than Supabase Realtime at scale) |
| Typesense for provider search | FTS p95 > 500ms | Typesense Cloud ~$50/month; sync provider profiles via Supabase webhook on update |
| Upgrade Supabase to Large compute | DB CPU > 70% sustained | Large plan: 8 vCPU, 32GB RAM |
| Add Postgres read replica | Read:write ratio > 5:1 | Route GET requests (search, KPI reads) to replica; writes stay on primary |
| AI no-show v2 (ML model) | Rule-based accuracy < 70% | Logistic regression: 6 features (no_show_count, booking_lead_time, time_of_day, category, day_of_week, distance_km); retrain weekly on Fly.io |

### 10.3 100,000 → 1,000,000 Users

| Action | Trigger | Implementation |
|---|---|---|
| Extract payments service | Payment webhook queue > 100 | Dedicated Node.js microservice on Railway with own Postgres pool |
| Extract GPS service | gps_pings write throughput > 2k/s | TimescaleDB or ClickHouse for time-series GPS data; Supabase retained for transactional tables |
| Multi-city sharding | Lagos + Abuja + PH isolated | Separate Supabase projects per region; unified auth via custom JWT with `city_id` claim |
| Expand to Nairobi + Accra | > 100k NGN MAU | Add M-Pesa Daraja for Kenya (Africa's Talking AT-Money fallback); MTN MoMo for Ghana |
| AI Operations v3 | Re-booking nudge CTR < 10% | Real-time feature store (Redis) updated on each booking event; personalised nudge copy via OpenAI |

## Assumptions Made

- **Default stack used for**: Next.js 14 (App Router), Expo SDK 51, Supabase Postgres 15, Supabase Edge Functions (Deno), Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui, Turborepo monorepo
- **Payment provider**: Paystack for all NGN transactions; Paystack Split used to disburse provider share automatically at job completion; Cash tracking via `cash_payments` table
- **SMS provider**: Termii for all OTP and booking notifications (West Africa primary)
- **USSD fallback**: Africa's Talking USSD — enabled from launch for provider feature-phone users (many skilled tradespeople in Nigeria use non-smart devices)
- **Target market assumed**: Nigeria — Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt; currency NGN
- **Background check implementation**: HomePro partners with a third-party identity/background check service (e.g. Smile Identity, Trulioo); `background_check_status` updated via their webhook to `passed` before provider goes live; check fee ₦3,500 passed to provider at onboarding
- **Deposit policy default**: 30% of job value; enforced server-side via `businesses.deposit_policy` jsonb; configurable per business
- **No-show policy**: after 3 missed jobs, `require_prepayment = true` on `customer_profiles`; full amount required upfront
- **GPS tracking**: only active when booking is in `dispatched`/`checked_in`/`in_progress` status; automatically stopped on `completed`/`cancelled`
- **Video not applicable**: home services is an in-person vertical; no video consultation required
- **Provider payout timing**: end-of-day batch payout after balance charge on job completion; Paystack split credit lands in provider recipient account within 1 business day
- **Class-based booking**: not applicable — each booking is a 1:1 provider-to-home job; EXCLUDE USING gist prevents double-scheduling of providers
- **Franchise model assumed from Q4**: initial Q1–Q3 is marketplace only (independent providers); franchise engine enables cleaning companies to list multiple operatives under one business in Q4
